title: Rest Client java.util.regex.PatternSyntaxException: Dangling meta character '*' near index 0 when setting http.nonProxyHosts
body:
### Describe the bug

I have REST Client injected to my resource class. 
```
@Path("/hello")
public class GreetingResource {
	
    @Inject
    @RestClient
    HelloResourceClient helloResourceClient;

    @GET
    @Produces(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN)
    public String hello() {
        return "Hello RESTEasy";
    }
}
```

When I run appliaction without proxy settings i works fine but when I set proxy parameters `-Dhttps.proxyHost=proxy.acme.com -Dhttps.proxyPort=3128 -Dhttp.proxyHost=proxy.acme.com -Dhttp.proxyPort=3128 -Dhttp.nonProxyHosts="*.acme.com|*.acme.app"` it throws an exception:
